authorization: Author approved an ARI-coverage-adapted, mirror-symmetric Q26 after the original SONICOM Q26 mapping was rejected.

q26.selection: two median-plane anchors (0,-30),(0,80) plus deterministic greedy maximin selection of 12 exact mirror pairs from the common ARI measured grid; pair-internal separation included; lexicographic source-index tie-break

signal.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly(up=147,down=160); right-zero-pad 236 samples to 256; no time alignment
signal.itd: retain delay through common polyphase resampling

evaluation.weights: spherical Voronoi areas normalized over the evaluation subset
evaluation.statistics: subject-level mean/sample SD; FSC-MCA paired bootstrap 10000, seed 20260911

test_policy: No test Data.IR reads until adapter/config are frozen and E190 is complete; one authorized test pass only.
